BiblicalUsage: A curse is the judgment God pronounces on disobedience, and the word is used where the curse falls: Moses says the LORD will send cursing and vexation on a people who forsake Him, and Proverbs says the curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked. Malachi says the priests will be cursed for despising God's name, and that the whole nation is cursed with a curse for robbing God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the curse is the other side of the blessing: God sets both before His people, and the curse is not spite but the honest consequence of turning from the One who blesses. The way out is the same in every verse — return to Him, and the curse is lifted.
